profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Senior Software Engineer with over 25 years of expertise in software development, audio programming, and immersive 3D audio content creation. Proven track record of designing, implementing, and maintaining high-quality software solutions using a diverse range of technologies including Python, C++, Java, and various audio engines. Adept at collaborating with cross-functional teams to translate user stories and functional requirements into resilient and secure solutions. Strong background in developing tools for both music instruction software and interactive gaming environments. Committed to continuous learning and professional development, with multiple certifications in cloud computing, AI, and data science.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed, implemented, tested, documented, and maintained high-quality software solutions using Python, Postgres, Hasura, GitLab, GitHub, Jira, and Confluence.
• Collaborated with team leads, project managers, and team members to translate user stories and functional requirements into resilient and secure solutions.
• Evaluated new technologies, including the use of Generative AI programming assistants such as GitHub Copilot.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Python (Programming Language) · Git · Machine Learning · Algorithms · Software Development · Software Industry · Docker · Agile Methodologies · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed tools to support the creation of immersive 3D audio content for the MSG Sphere’s Holoplot wavefield synthesis system.
• Developed a tool in C++ for processing multiple streams of PCM audio data, both as a JUCE plugin and as a standalone app that also handled OSC commands related to audio data manipulation.
positions.insights: Skills: Concurrent Programming · JUCE · Git · Reaper · Algorithms · Desktop Application Development · Debugging · Code Review · Problem Solving · Computer Science · Data Structures

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed music instruction software projects and maintained in-house software tools.
• Wrote technical specifications and documentation, and evaluated development platforms.
• Produced software using Adobe Director and Lingo scripting language, maintained and extended Perl scripts, and wrote software plugins in C++ for MIDI playback and audio analysis.
• Worked on iOS versions of eMedia products using Objective C and used R to generate Decision Trees for guitar chord recognition.
positions.insights: Skills: Concurrent Programming · Java · Git · Algorithms · Desktop Application Development · Debugging · Problem Solving · Computer Science · Unity · Data Structures

positions.title: Senior Audio Programmer
positions.description:
• Maintained and improved audio components of PopCap’s internal framework and tools, including integrating third-party audio engines.
• Integrated Audiokinetic Wwise engine into the internal software framework (written primarily in C++).
• Assisted game teams in using audio tools and APIs correctly, and collaborated with PopCap’s audio team on new features and integration of audio functionality.
positions.insights: Skills: Concurrent Programming · Algorithms · Debugging · Code Review · Problem Solving · Computer Science · Data Structures · Interactive Music

positions.insights: Skills: Java · Git · Algorithms · Desktop Application Development · Debugging · Problem Solving · Computer Science · Unity · Data Structures

positions.title: Software Design Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed, implemented, and maintained the GUI and audio engine for XACT, an audio creation tool for Xbox and Windows.
• Participated in the design and implementation of LEAP, a low-level audio API, and the performance layer of the Direct Music API for DX7, DX8, and
DX9.
positions.insights: Skills: Concurrent Programming · .NET Framework · Algorithms · Desktop Application Development · Debugging · Code Review · Problem Solving · C# · Computer Science · Data Structures · Interactive Music

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: • Developed software for the interactive music portion of the Direct Music API for DX6.1.
positions.insights: Skills: Algorithms · Desktop Application Development · Debugging · Code Review · Problem Solving · Computer Science · Data Structures · Interactive Music

positions.title: Assistant Professor
positions.description:
• Taught courses in introductory programming, Data Structures, and Artificial Intelligence using C++, C, and Common Lisp.
• Developed software for courses and research, and advised Masters Thesis students in machine learning and computer music.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Algorithms · Computer Science · Data Structures · Common Lisp

positions.title: Research Associate
positions.description: • Contributed to the Natural Language Group's participation in the third Message Understanding Conference.
